semantics.numeric: IEEE-754 double; truncation toward zero; roundEven matches Math.Round midpoint-to-even
semantics.evaluation: Steps in order; call arguments follow named formula input order; if, and are lazy
semantics.rounding: Integer divisions are explicit trunc(div(...)); no implicit rounding
semantics.missing: Missing or nonfinite inputs, arithmetic outside signed 32-bit bounds, invalid operations and division by zero are errors; consumers expose unknowns. Overflow wrapping is unsupported
semantics.trust: Only bundled, validated formulas are evaluated. Imported descriptions and formulas are never executed.
